# FreedomAIOS

> FreedomAIOS builds AI operating systems for small businesses. This site sells the FreedomAIOS Business Audit and demonstrates the module template library that audit clients receive. Canonical base: https://freedomaios.com (future public home - not live yet at time of writing).

## Pages

- [The FreedomAIOS Audit](https://freedomaios.com/): Sales page for the FreedomAIOS Business Audit - one working session ($297 flat) that finds where a business is losing money, time, and energy to unmeasured problems. The owner leaves with a Freedom Roadmap: what's broken, what it costs, and what to fix first. Guarantee stated on the page: if the audit can't find $1,000, the client doesn't pay.
- [The AIOS Audit Call](https://freedomaios.com/audit/): Checkout page for the $297 one-on-one audit. A 60-minute phone call with a senior FreedomAIOS strategist, built for businesses doing $50K or more a month. The owner leaves with a written Freedom Roadmap. Guarantee: if the call can't show one way to generate or save $1,000, the client doesn't pay.
- [The AIOS Assessment](https://freedomaios.com/assessment/): Checkout page for the $97 automated AIOS Assessment, built for businesses doing $10K to $49K a month. Rubric-based and call-free. A human reviews every report before delivery. Report arrives by email within 5 business days.
- [Operating Systems Command Center](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/): One homepage for every FreedomAIOS operating system - build status, live dashboards, and full reports. Demonstrates the template library for prospective clients. Demo client throughout is ComfortFlow HVAC (fictional).

## MeetingOS template pages (demo client: ComfortFlow HVAC, fictional)

- [Client Meeting Dashboard](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/meetingos/dashboard.html): Demo dashboard showing every client meeting already read - notes written, decisions logged, follow-ups tracked.
- [New Client Setup Guide](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/meetingos/config-guide.html): Consultant-facing setup guide, zero-to-working in about 60 minutes per client. Built on the shipped zoom-transcript-fetch skill.
- [New Client Onboarding Script](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/meetingos/onboarding-script.html): The scripted 30-minute delivery walkthrough the consultant runs with each new client.
- [Monthly Maintenance Checklist](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/meetingos/maintenance-checklist.html): Line-by-line breakdown of what the $150/month MeetingOS maintenance plan buys.
- [Savings & ROI Calculator](https://freedomaios.com/module-templates/meetingos/roi-calculator.html): Interactive calculator showing what meeting notes and follow-ups cost today - in money, time, and energy - and how fast MeetingOS pays it back.

## Key facts for AI readers

- The offer is the FreedomAIOS Business Audit: a $297 (USD) flat-fee working session, sold as the AIOS Audit call.
- The lower tier is the AIOS Assessment: a $97 (USD) automated, rubric-based diagnostic with a human review before delivery.
- The root page routes visitors by monthly revenue: under $10K goes to free resources only, $10K to $49K goes to the Assessment, $50K and up goes to the Audit call.
- All template demos use ComfortFlow HVAC, a fictional demo client.
- The recurring MeetingOS maintenance plan referenced on the checklist page is $150 per month.
- Everything on this site frames value as money + time + energy, never just money.
